text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Shuka Sho. Fine Motion drew 
immense attention as the overwhelming 
favorite. But confronted with the crowd's 
expectations, she bolted off somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She was worried that by running purely for 
fun, she might shatter the noble image 
everyone expected of her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Trainer tells her that what people 
really hope for is to see her run with 
joy. Fine Motion made up her mind to run 
with all the joy in her heart.
